owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

paused().details: Returns true if the contract is paused, and false otherwise.

renounceOwnership().details: Override to prevent renouncing ownership while the contract is paused, which would permanently lock `submitEvent` with no way to unpause.

params.eventId: A unique identifier for this event (e.g. keccak256 of tx hash + log index from the source protocol).                Prevents a reporter from replaying the same event to inflate or tank a score.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

getHistory(address).notice: Returns up to the last 50 credit events (recent history).         All events are still counted in the score — the ring buffer only affects display.

submitEvent(address,uint8,uint256,bytes3.notice: Submit a verified credit event for a wallet.
